tasks.title: _grep_config: count module-reference forms only, not arbitrary config keys
acceptance_criteria: harness/wire_up._grep_config matches a stem only as a module reference (stem.py, dotted pkg.stem / stem.sub, or -m <module>), never a bare identifier / JSON key
tasks.objective: Tighten harness/wire_up._grep_config so a config reference is counted only when the module stem appears in a MODULE-reference context (a stem.py file path, a dotted-path segment like pkg.stem or stem.sub, or a `-m <module>` target), and NOT when the stem is merely a bare identifier or JSON object key. This removes the false CONFIG_WIRED verdict (e.g. the unrelated "actions" JSON key in config/gemini_settings.json) that masked the real orphan overseer/actions.py.

spec.objective: Tighten harness/wire_up._grep_config so a config reference is counted only when the module stem appears in a MODULE-reference context (a stem.py file path, a dotted-path segment like pkg.stem or stem.sub, or a `-m <module>` target), and NOT when the stem is merely a bare identifier or JSON object key. This removes the false CONFIG_WIRED verdict (e.g. the unrelated "actions" JSON key in config/gemini_settings.json) that masked the real orphan overseer/actions.py.
functional_requirements: _grep_config keeps its exact signature `_grep_config(repo_root: Path, stem: str) -> str` and its return contract: the POSIX rel-path of the FIRST config file under repo_root/config/** whose text references the stem as a module, else '' (empty string).

The match must succeed for: a `stem.py` path token (with any path prefix, e.g. overseer/actions.py); a dotted-path tail (e.g. overseer.actions, i.e. stem immediately preceded by a dot); a dotted-path head (e.g. actions.handlers, i.e. stem immediately followed by a dot and an identifier char); and a bare `-m <stem>` target (e.g. `python3 -m config_only`).

The match must FAIL for: a bare identifier / JSON object key (e.g. `"actions":`); the stem appearing inside a longer identifier (e.g. `actions` inside `transactions.py` -- word boundary preserved); and a bare prose word.

All other behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged: the `config_dir.is_dir()` guard returning '', the sorted rglob walk, the per-file read with errors='ignore' and OSError skip, and the relative_to/ValueError return logic.
Pure: stdlib only (re already imported at module top). No process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess; only filesystem reads.
spec.interfaces: _grep_config(repo_root: Path, stem: str) -> str -- unchanged signature and return contract; only the internal match pattern is tightened. Its callers (sweep_modules at the CONFIG_WIRED branch, check_wired's config_ref branch) are NOT modified.
edge_cases: Bare JSON key `"actions": {` with stem 'actions' -> no match (returns '').
`-m config_only` (bare module, no dots, no .py) with stem 'config_only' -> match (this is the form tests/harness/test_sweep_classifier.py depends on).
`overseer.actions` (dotted tail) and `actions.handlers` (dotted head) with stem 'actions' -> match.
`transactions.py` with stem 'actions' -> NO match (the stem is a strict substring; the leading word-boundary lookbehind prevents it).
No config/ directory -> returns '' without raising; unreadable file -> skipped.
non_goals: No change to the function signature, the file-walk order, the read/skip logic, or the return-path construction.
No change to sweep_modules, check_wired, SweepReport, WireResult, LIVE_ROOTS, discover_live_roots, _resolved_graph, or mcp_crosscheck.
No new module-level import (re is already imported at the top of harness/wire_up.py).

unit_tests: bare JSON key is not a module reference (no match)
stem.py path / dotted tail / dotted head / bare -m target all match
substring inside a longer identifier does not match
live config 'actions' key yields no match
regression_tests: tests/harness/test_sweep_classifier.py still passes (config_only via -m stays CONFIG_WIRED)
test_spec.test_data_requirements: Hermetic tmp config trees supplied by the committed oracle plus a read of the real config/ tree.
